name: Julie Johnson
bio: Julie Elizabeth Johnson is an American politician and attorney serving as a U.S. representative from Texas's 32nd congressional district since 2025. A member of the Democratic Party, she previously served as a member of the Texas House of Representatives. Johnson, an out lesbian, is the first openly LGBTQ+ member of Congress from a Southern state.
